fields.statement: This change set builds on accepted 01M78FD0 (depends-on). Its leaves are new capabilities because 01M78FD0's nodes are not landed: ci-unstable-repeated-flake narrows ci-stability-state and 01M78FD0's local-gate-trigger-identified-flakes (2 flakes of one named test, not one identified flake); ship-gate-run-log replaces 01M78FD0's ship-gate-full-log log location (one file per gate run in the run dir, not rhiza/gate/<branch>.log replaced each run, except outside a run). Decision local-gate-repeated-named-flakes rules. Not breaking: ShipGateResponse and the CI stability record only gain fields.
